svg.title: RB01 storage layout
svg.desc: Bars proportional to bytes show, for the dense model, the four-expert mixture, and the delta-expert model, how much of the stored weights are shared path versus expert bank, and how much of each a single token touches under top-1 and top-2 routing.
svg.text: RB01 STORAGE -- what is stored, what one token touches
WHAT: f64 bytes [D]; 900 px = 64 KiB; blue = shared path, pink = experts touched this token, grey = untouched
DN01 dense: shared path only (the FFN is part of it)
MX01 stored: shared path + 4 experts; top-1 touches one
MX02 stored: the same bytes; top-2 touches two
LD01 stored: shared path (with the shared FFN) + 16 deltas; top-1 touches one
one expert [M/D]: 8,576 B f64 = 4,288 B FP32 = 2,144 B FP16 = 1,072 B INT8 = 536 B INT4 payload; a rank-4 delta is 1,024 B f64
WHY: MoE promises stored capacity above active: MX01 stores 1.86x DN01 and touches 1.02x per token; top-2 adds one expert.
WHY: caching matters only when the bank exceeds what is resident; at 4 experts all is resident, so XC01 builds a large bank.
HOW: lib/budget.mlpl computes every count from a configuration, pinned to param_count of the lessons; see resource-budget.md.
M measured, D derived, E estimate; no number here is a training result, so the diagram changes only when a model does.
